sentences.en: Algeria is undergoing a crisis of legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚正经历一场合法性的危机。
阿尔及利亚恢复了其合法性。

sentences.en: The separatists need to invent myths in order to give some legitimacy to their delusional claims.
sentences.zh: 分离主义者需要编造一些神话来为他们荒诞的主张赋予一定的合法性。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：legitim（=legis法律）+acy （性质）→合法性
